propositions: _paged_search lacks an offset-stall guard; a server that ignores startAt re-serves the same page forever, spinning unbounded instead of terminating
get_parent_map's broad except-Exception handler swallows any pagination stall error raised by _paged_search and converts it to a silent empty map
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) also swallow pagination stall errors via broad fail-open exception handlers, silently degrading snapshots
A DC server capping pages short is normal behavior with more data to give, so adopting fetcher's short-page termination branch would silently truncate results (20 of 250) rather than detect stall
The stall error belongs in core _backend.py alongside other Backend* errors so fetcher.py and adapters can both name it without layering inversion
